meta.name: create-agent
meta.description: Create a new custom agent for the workspace. Guides the user through defining agent name, domain, personality, skills, model, and memory folder. Use when the user says 'create an agent', 'new agent', 'add an agent', 'I need a custom agent', or wants to create a specialized agent for a specific domain.

howto.what: Claude 会引导你一步步创建自定义 agent：先询问名称、领域、个性、模型等，然后自动生成 agent 的配置文件、快捷命令和记忆文件夹。
howto.when: 当你说“create an agent”、“new agent”等关键词，或表示需要某个专门领域的 agent 时触发。

howto.what_en: Claude guides you step by step to create a custom agent: ask for name, domain, personality, model, etc., then auto-generate the agent config file, slash command, and memory folder.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "create an agent", "new agent", or express a need for a specialized domain agent.
